id: title:andyzzhao:add a seen cache to the events worker

review.posthog_relevance: Adds shared cache capacity configuration and cache rollover metrics to support property value deduplication and cache behavior observability.
review.reason: The change introduces a shared cache capacity configuration and a daily cache rollover mechanism, including a new metrics counter (`SEEN_CACHE_ROLLS`) to distinguish rollovers from evictions. This supports PostHog's property value deduplication and cache management, potentially reducing memory usage and aiding debugging. The implementation and relevant checks are visible in the hks
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit of shared cache and rollover behavior is not demonstrated, and the configuration and metrics are not verified. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.
